sampling: Start is exact subshot start; end is 0.01 authored scene seconds before its boundary to remain inside that subshot. Ambient clock equals mapped playback seconds. These are deterministic code-frame samples, not video model results.
productionCompositionDifference: Current code-frame family door is on the upper edge. Model-production prompts 001–002 use a proposed right-side door opening onto the right street. These PNGs preserve actual code geometry and were not rerendered as the proposed composition.
